messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, then raises her right arm to touch her hair before lowering it and shifting her weight slightly.","camera":"The camera starts with a medium shot from behind and slowly zooms out to a full-body shot, remaining static otherwise.","clothing":"A white, short-sleeved mini dress with a floral pattern of pink, yellow, and blue flowers, featuring cold-shoulder cutouts and a low back, paired with orange sneakers.","hair_color":"Reddish-brown.","hairstyle":"Reddish-brown hair styled in a low bun with two small pigtails tied with red bands.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and dark brown skin, shown from behind.","scene":"An outdoor urban rooftop or plaza with wet, reflective pavement, featuring a metal tower structure on the left and tall city buildings with billboards in the background under a clear sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The ocean, pier, and stone waterfront were replaced by a city rooftop/plaza with a metal tower, buildings, billboards, and wet reflective pavement. The character's pose, dress, hair, and zoom-out camera movement remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the seaside background with the urban rooftop environment from the reference, including its lighting, while preserving the character, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the new lighting on the person exactly matches the reference image's intended lighting.
unexpected_changes: The character's hair appears more saturated reddish-brown in the output than in the source, likely due to the new lighting.
